Carmen: Anyone else onboarding with the new JS SDK sample for edge + Vite? Hitting TS overload/generic inference weirdness.
Diego: what errors do you see? paste tsconfig and snippet.
Carmen: main TS: `TS2345: Argument of type 'unknown' is not assignable to parameter of type 'T'` when calling `client.runTool<{rows:number}>`. Also 'No overload matches this call'. tsconfig: { \"module\": \"esnext\", \"moduleResolution\": \"bundler\", \"strict\": true }.
Lin: bundlers (vite/esbuild) sometimes resolve the wrong export and fallback to the CJS path which changes how types are read. Are you using default import?
Carmen: yeah `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` in the template.
Aya: switch to named: `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'` — fixes runtime missing-methods due to default interop.
Carmen: that fixed runtime `client.execute is not a function` but TS still collapses the tool response to unknown.
Diego: could be overloads + conditional types in .d.ts. Quick local hack: add `skipLibCheck: true` or set `moduleResolution` to `node16`. Both unblock but are not great long-term.
Lin: long-term we should: (1) provide explicit `types/edge/index.d.ts` and an `exports` condition for edge/types so bundlers pick a stable types entry, (2) simplify overloads so TS inference isn't fragile, or (3) ship an opt-in strict types entry for power-users.
Aya: UX tradeoff: `unknown` is safe but forces casts; `any` is friendly for quickstarts but hides issues. Maybe default package stays ergonomic and we add `@redwood/inference/strict` types-only path.
Carmen: also saw auth/retry differences: in Cloudflare workers fetch errors don't include Node error codes and our retry wrapper calls `req.destroy()` in some flows which doesn't exist.
Diego: add a platform guard in retry: detect worker vs Node and avoid node-only calls. Normalize error shape at boundary.
Lin: tiny repro to reproduce TS issue:
```
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const c = new RedwoodClient()
const res = await c.tool<{ kind:'rows'; rows:number }>('parse')
if (res.kind === 'rows') console.log(res.rows)
```
Carmen: TS says `Property 'kind' does not exist on type 'unknown'` despite the generic.
Aya: action items:
- Lin: add a `types/edge` declaration and update package exports so Vite/esbuild pick the right types (owner: Lin)
- Diego: implement edge-safe retry/auth guards and a `normalizeError` util (owner: Diego)
- Carmen: add minimal repro under `examples/edge/vite-ts` with recommended tsconfigs (owner: Carmen)
- Aya: draft typings migration doc: ergonomic default + opt-in strict path (owner: Aya)
ops-bot: created issue RED-999: "edge SDK: types inference + exports parity + auth/retry normalization" https://issues.internal/RED-999
Carmen: I'll push the repro and link it here. If anyone else sees weird inference please drop your tsconfig + bundler version in #devex. :seedling:
